product.title: Silicone Grip D-Ring Lifting Straps
product.descriptionHtml:
Your grip should never be the reason a set ends.

One Percent lifting straps lock around your wrist with a padded neoprene cuff, so the load sits on the strap, not your fingers. Deadlifts, rows, shrugs and pulls: keep the bar moving long after your grip would have quit.

  • Silicone anti-slip grip. Raised silicone dots along the 30cm strap bite into the bar and hold.
  • 5mm neoprene wrist padding. Soft, breathable, and spreads the load across your wrist.
  • Double D-ring cuff. The strap anchors on steel D-rings, and the hook and loop closure adjusts to fit most wrists.
  • One size, sold as a pair.

Better daily. Built for people who train like the last one percent is the part that counts.
